name: agents-panel
description: A live Agents pane: a progress bar for the helpers, what the main loop is doing, every shell command of the session, and one card per helper agent or Codex run with its current action, recent actions, task, progress, tokens, approximate cost and time; plus a Thread pane, its own tab beside Agents, with each prompt you typed and the first paragraph of the answer; click a prompt to jump to it in the conversation

showPane.title: Show the Agents pane
showPane.description: The side pane with one card per helper agent. Off: it never opens by itself and /agents-panel says it is off.

showBand.title: Show the progress bar above the prompt too
showBand.description: The helpers' progress bar (tasks done, percent and time left) is always at the top of the Agents pane. On: it is also drawn above the prompt while helpers run.
